outcome_margin_regression.interpretation: The model expresses about 54 percent of observed strength-difference amplitude.

intercept_cannot_repair_slope.interpretation: A home intercept helps home favorites and harms away favorites; it cannot correct global amplitude.

contamination_disclosure.rule: No fixture appearing in either disclosed set may enter validation or test, regardless of later re-extraction or identity spelling.

model_change_hypothesis.raw_delta: base_home - base_away before home advantage and optional enhancements
unchanged: total = base_home + base_away subject to existing total clamps
model_change_hypothesis.forbidden_interpretation: This slope task does not recalibrate total-goals expectation.

universe.competitions: The exact production-enabled competition set resolved at fixture kickoff; freeze its IDs in each extraction artifact.
universe.completion: authoritative FT, AET or PEN result with unambiguous home and away regulation-plus-extra-time goals under the existing settlement authority
universe.duplicate_rule: one row per canonical fixture; identity conflict fails closed

train.role: fit raw_delta_scale and produce rolling-origin OOF development diagnostics

validation.start: T0 is the activation timestamp recorded by an immutable pre-kickoff shadow-evaluation receipt after the fitted parameter, candidate calibration identity and writer code revision are frozen; T0 must precede every included fixture kickoff
validation.selection: the first 2,500 eligible fixtures with kickoff_at > T0 in ascending (kickoff_at, fixture_id) order after excluding every disclosed development fixture
validation.role: one-shot go/no-go validation; never parameter or threshold selection
validation.look_rule: outcomes and metrics remain sealed until all 2,500 model records and outcomes are eligible

test.selection: the next 4,000 eligible fixtures immediately after the frozen validation set in ascending (kickoff_at, fixture_id) order
test.look_rule: do not open, aggregate or serialize any test outcome or metric before validation has passed unchanged and all 4,000 test fixtures are eligible

cross_split_rules: A fixture belongs to exactly one split.
No competition, season or direction may be removed after counts or metrics are observed.
Missing PIT input is an exclusion with a recorded reason before outcome access, never an imputation from later data.
Validation and test boundaries are determined by eligible fixture order, not by metric values.

xg_input.preferred: team_xg_rolling_snapshot whose as_of_fixture_id equals the target fixture and whose source rows are strictly pre-kickoff
xg_input.fallback: rebuild running means from team_xg_match rows with kickoff_at strictly earlier than target kickoff
xg_input.window: the same latest-five production point-estimate semantics used by the deployed V1 path
xg_input.snapshot_and_rebuild: report separately; never pool without also reporting each path

non_xg_inputs.elo: pass only through existing _eligible_elo; proxy-only values remain zero contribution
non_xg_inputs.squad_value: use only values visible before kickoff under the existing production as-of rule
non_xg_inputs.lineup: use only confirmed lineup evidence captured before the frozen evaluation checkpoint
non_xg_inputs.missing: retain existing zero/absent contribution; no backfill from future evidence

market_input.devig: PROPORTIONAL as implemented, regardless of provenance labels
market_input.checkpoint: use the existing production checkpoint and mainline-selection rule; record quote IDs, bookmaker depth, selected line, prices and captured_at

point_in_time_rules.anti_leakage_freeze: For every validation and test fixture, an append-only shadow writer must freeze the candidate prediction, post-clamp lambdas, fair AH line, selected market quote, input-path label, calibration identity and model identity before kickoff and before any outcome access. The activation receipt fixes T0, writer revision and candidate identity before the first eligible kickoff. Each artifact receives a SHA-256; a fixture without a pre-kickoff record is excluded with a pre-outcome reason and may never be reconstructed later for acceptance.

fit_method.objective: fixture-level Dixon-Coles-corrected Poisson negative log likelihood of the observed scoreline under the unchanged production lambda clamps
fit_method.optimizer: deterministic golden-section search on the closed interval [0.5, 3.0] until interval width <= 0.000001; ties choose the smaller value
fit_method.precision: store the optimizer result at 6 decimal places; code uses exactly that stored decimal

oof_method.purpose: development estimator stability only; it grants no acceptance authority
oof_method.method: rolling-origin expanding window; fit only fixtures strictly earlier than the fold, predict the fold once
report: per-fold fixture count and kickoff range
OOF AH fair-minus-market and underdog cashflow edge when PIT quotes exist
oof_method.forbidden_use: OOF results may not change this method, bounds, metrics or thresholds

identity_contract.calibration_version: must be incremented before implementation because the lambda formula changes
identity_contract.params: LambdaCalibrationParams must add raw_delta_scale and retain every existing field
identity_contract.safety_property: Any formula-version or parameter change produces a different calibration identity; old 0.30 authorization cannot carry forward.
identity_contract.model_identity: bind exact code revision, formula version and complete params snapshot separately from calibration identity
identity_contract.config_hash: bind the canonical digest of every runtime-effective non-secret model configuration value
identity_contract.grant_rule: No ledger registration until validation and test both pass and their immutable evidence digests are available.

net_margin_regression.definition: OLS of observed home-minus-away final margin on the frozen pre-match model lambda_home-minus-lambda_away after the production total clamp and individual lambda clamps, with intercept; fixture is the resampling unit

fair_minus_market.fair_line: home-perspective quarter line minimizing absolute five-state expected cashflow at decimal odds 2.00
fair_minus_market.favorite_strength_shortfall: signed so positive means the market makes the favorite stronger than the model; report all, home-favorite and away-favorite separately

underdog_cashflow_price_edge.definition: production five-state cashflow_price_edge at the selected executable underdog quote; underdog is determined from the market AH line, not home/away label

secondary_1X2.binding_guard: for each of home, draw and away, the fixture-bootstrap probability that absolute relative bias exceeds 0.05 must be <= 0.05
secondary_1X2.role: binding regression guard only; passing 1X2 can never substitute for a failed AH metric, and failure cannot be averaged against AH results

uncertainty.multiple_metric_rule: Every primary AH condition must pass on validation and again on test; no averaging or compensation across metrics.

power_and_timing.scaling_rule: Approximate slope CI half-width scales as 1/sqrt(N) with the same fixture mix.
power_and_timing.rule: Both the required eligible count and the not-before timestamp must be satisfied; calendar time alone never opens metrics.

look_and_failure_rules.before_validation_look: report eligible counts and exclusion reasons only; do not calculate or expose validation metrics
look_and_failure_rules.validation_look: exactly once at N=2500 and not before T0 plus 12.5 months, after every prediction artifact was frozen before kickoff and outcome access
on_validation_failure: do not change the fitted value, model threshold or blocker
a different hypothesis requires a new preregistration and new untouched cohorts
look_and_failure_rules.on_validation_pass: freeze the pass receipt and unchanged fitted parameter before opening test
look_and_failure_rules.test_look: exactly once at N=4000 and not before T0 plus 32.5 months
look_and_failure_rules.on_test_pass: prepare an evidence-bound APPROVED_VALIDATED registration proposal for the new identity; registration and deployment remain separate Owner-authorized actions
look_and_failure_rules.interim_fault_look: none; this is an undeployed candidate and has no operational stop-loss need

totals_exclusion.reason: home_advantage_goals and raw_delta_scale conserve the pre-individual-clamp total by construction. Individual lambda clamps can still move the final lambda sum for boundary fixtures, so clamp-hit fixtures must be reported separately; that incidental effect is neither a TOTALS fit nor evidence that TOTALS is repaired.
totals_exclusion.required_future_action: Freeze a separate TOTALS-specific preregistration with a total-scale hypothesis, untouched cohorts and TOTALS acceptance metrics before any TOTALS fit.
